title: Hitler to Thomas the Tank Engine?
description:
Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Thomas the Tank Engine, through Finland's wartime marshal, a future Finnish president, John F. Kennedy, a British prime minister and a Beatle.

Adolf Hitler → Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim → Urho Kekkonen → John F. Kennedy → Harold Wilson → Ringo Starr → Thomas the Tank Engine

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Mannerheim: In 1942, Hitler flew to Finland for Marshal Mannerheim's birthday.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hitler_visit_Finland_1942.jpg
2. Mannerheim → Urho Kekkonen: In 1940, Mannerheim watched sports beside Urho Kekkonen, a future president.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Famous_spectators_of_athletics_game_Finland-Sweden-Germany,_September_1940_in_Helsinki.jpg
3. Urho Kekkonen → John F. Kennedy: In 1961, John F. Kennedy welcomed President Kekkonen to America.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kekkonen_valtiovierailulla_Yhdysvalloissa.jpg
4. John F. Kennedy → Harold Wilson: In 1963, Kennedy met Britain's Harold Wilson at the White House.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_John_F._Kennedy_with_Leader_of_the_Labour_Party_of_Great_Britain,_Harold_Wilson.jpg
5. Harold Wilson → Ringo Starr: In 1964, Wilson gave Ringo Starr and the Beatles an award.
   Photo by Mirrorpix (via YorkshireLive), Fair use (commentary): https://www.examinerlive.co.uk/news/west-yorkshire-news/gallery/harold-wilson-7944879
6. Ringo Starr → Thomas the Tank Engine: And in 1984, Ringo Starr became the voice of Thomas the Tank Engine.
   Photo by Thomas the Tank Engine & Friends publicity photo (via Thomas & Friends Wiki), Fair use (commentary): https://ttte.fandom.com/wiki/File:RingoStarrwithThomas1984.jpg

Research notes: Instead of the usual Chamberlain or Franco exit, this chain leaves Hitler through Finland: a 1940 photo shows Mannerheim beside Kekkonen at a Helsinki athletics match, and the JFK Library has Kekkonen's 1961 state visit; a Finnish archive photo of Kekkonen with Harold Wilson exists, but its host blocks automated downloads, so the route runs through Kennedy.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #thomasthetankengine #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment:
Fun fact from the research: During Hitler's 1942 visit, a Finnish radio sound engineer secretly recorded the first 11 minutes of his talk with Mannerheim, the only known recording of Hitler speaking in an unofficial, everyday voice.

Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
